Compare Fire Detection Patterns Between Two Months

compare_fire_periods.Rd

Compares the volume, geographic spread and concentration of satellite-detected fire activity between two months in Australia's 2019-2020 fire season.

Usage

compare_fire_periods(month_a, month_b, data = fire_cells, top_n = 10L)

Arguments

month_a

Character string in YYYY-MM format. The first comparison month.

month_b

Character string in YYYY-MM format. The second comparison month.

data

A data frame containing the monthly grid-cell observations. Defaults to the packaged fire_cells data.

top_n

Positive whole number of grid cells used to calculate the concentration measure. Default is 10.

Value

A list containing:

summary

A two-row data frame with detection totals, occupied grid cells, and top-cell concentration percentages.

comparison

A one-row data frame describing the difference between the two selected months.

grid_data

Grid-cell observations for both months, suitable for visualisation.

Details

The concentration measure is the percentage of detections recorded in the top_n most active 1-degree grid cells within each month.

A higher percentage indicates that detections were more concentrated in a small number of grid cells.

Grid cells are not equal-area, and satellite detections do not directly represent burned area or fire severity.

Examples

compare_fire_periods("2019-11", "2020-01")
#> $summary
#>     month total_detections occupied_cells top_n_cells top_cell_share_pct
#> 1 2019-11            47138            333          10              54.22
#> 2 2020-01            36994            303          10              59.41
#> 
#> $comparison
#>   month_a month_b detection_change detection_change_pct occupied_cell_change
#> 1 2019-11 2020-01           -10144               -21.52                  -30
#>   concentration_change_pp
#> 1                    5.19
#>
